infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BuildGuard Pro needs access to your camera to capture construction photos with AR overlay and GPS metadata.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BuildGuard Pro needs access to your location to tag photos with GPS coordinates and provide site proximity information.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BuildGuard Pro needs access to your location for continuous tracking during site visits.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BuildGuard Pro needs access to your photo library to save construction documentation.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: BuildGuard Pro uses motion sensors to capture device orientation for AR features.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow BuildGuard Pro to access your camera to capture construction photos.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow BuildGuard Pro to use your location for photo geotagging and site proximity.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow BuildGuard Pro to access your photos to save construction documentation.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow BuildGuard Pro to save photos to your gallery.
